topics.title: POPULATION BY ETHNICITY, BY TOWNS/MUNICIPALITIES, 2021 CENSUS
topics.denominatorDefinition: Explicitly published Republic of Croatia national row, all usual residents; not reconstructed from county counts.

categories.sourceLabel:
Izjasnili se u smislu vjerske pripadnosti
Declared religion
categories.label: Declared religion

topics.definition: Self-declared ethnicity; original Croatian categories, including regional/religious affiliation, unclassified, not declared and unknown responses. Not harmonised with England/Wales categories.
topics.disclosureControl: Published national counts are preserved without adjustment. No county totals or regional distribution are inferred.
notes: The 2021 Census data on ethnicity are presented by listing the data on Croats as the majority people first, then those on 22 ethnic minorities in the Republic of Croatia in the alphabetical order, followed by data on other ethnicities, data on persons who declared their regional and religious affiliation, data on those whose answers could not be classified, and, at the end, data on not declared persons and on those of unknown ethnicity (answer was not given).

The religion for which the person declared was recorded in the Census questionnaire. If the person was agnostic, not religious or atheist, or did not want to declare, the enumerator recorded the answer as the person declared.

The 2021 Census data on religion are presented by the following groups: Catholics; Orthodox; Protestants; Other Christians; Muslims; Jews; Oriental religions; Other religions, movements and life philosophies; Agnostics and sceptics; Not religious and atheists, Not declared, Unknown.

1) U Ostale kršćane uključeno je 96,47% osoba koje su se na pitanje o vjeri izjasnile kao kršćani, od čega se na pitanje o vjerskoj zajednici 87,26% ispitanika izjasnilo da pripada Katoličkoj crkvi, njih 0,84% izjasnilo se da pripada Srpskoj pravoslavnoj crkvi u Hrvatskoj, dok se manje od 0,50% ispitanika pojedinačno izjasnilo da pripada ostalim vjerskim zajednicama.

1) Other Christians include 96.47% of persons who declared themselves as Christians when asked about their religious affiliation, of which, when asked about their religious community, 87.26% declared that they belonged to the Catholic Church, 0.84% declared that they belonged to the Serbian Orthodox Church in Croatia, while less than 0.50% of respondents individually declared that they belonged to other religious communities.
